verdict.rationale: Vast.ai documents its own Jupyter access. It has a dedicated Jupyter connect guide with a direct-connection option, Jupyter-ready templates such as PyTorch, and an instance portal that creates Cloudflare tunnels for open ports. IDE connectivity rests only on a one-line mention of 'VS Code support' alongside SSH terminal access, and the evidence shows no one-step IDE connect flow. missing for 10: evidence of a one-click/one-step IDE (VS Code/Cursor) connection, any mention of Cursor, detailed VS Code setup docs, independent hands-on corroboration of one-step Jupyter access.
